name: Jacob
overview: The Scriptures introduce Jacob as the younger twin son of Isaac, born after earnest prayer by his barren mother Rebekah, fulfilling God's promise that two nations would come from her womb with the elder serving the younger. Jacob’s birth is marked by his grasping Esau’s heel, symbolizing his future role and the divine plan that the younger son would carry forward the covenant. This foundation sets the stage for Jacob’s pivotal role in God's unfolding redemptive history as an ancestor of Jesus.
